claims.content: If a JU attempts to change the simulation status of a track due to operator error, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and a new track shall be reported.

If a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message for a remote subsurface track and receives no further updates, it may automatically purge those tracks (DRT = 0-3) after a specific time interval; however, DATUMS (DRT = 4) shall not be purged automatically.

If a JU ceases reporting an emergency point because the unit with R² is declared inactive or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive intervals, another JU may assume R² for the point by operator action only.

If differences in position, velocity, or altitude/elevation are recognized by a JU for Air, Surface, or Land tracks, they shall not generate a J7.0 (ACT = 2) message but may cause the JU to assume one TN represents two different tracks.
If differences in ballistic missile position or velocity are recognized by a JU, they shall not generate a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 1 (Difference Report).

If a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message; this message shall not be transmitted on remote reports, which may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
The transmission of EW product information is terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.
Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages provide nonC2 JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
Locally held remote tracks may be automatically purged by nonC2 JUs after a specified time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated.
